cases.text: Hreflang tags are HTML link elements placed in the <head> of each page that tell search engines which language and regional version of a page to serve to users. Each page lists all its language variants, including itself. The x-default value indicates the fallback page for users whose language is not specifically targeted. Correct implementation prevents duplicate content issues across language versions.

Messages reach vue-i18n exactly as authored in the dashboard, and vue-i18n resolves them at render time. Note that vue-i18n has its own message syntax: plurals are pipe-separated ('no items | one item | '{count}' items') rather than ICU, so author plural keys in that form, or register a custom message compiler built on intl-messageformat if your team writes ICU. When AI translates an ICU message, an automatic check flags any translation that drops a plural branch, renames a variable or loses the # placeholder.

cases.text: Publishing writes to R2 and fires a CDN purge, and the CDN sets max-age=60 on translations. The client's in-memory cache keys messages by the version the manifest advertises, so once the cached manifest expires (5 minutes by default in production, 30 seconds in development) the next getMessages() call picks up the new strings — no redeploy, no bundle rebuild. Call getManifest('{ forceRefresh: true }') if you need to bypass the cache during QA.
